en.title: Smallest String After Decrementing Exactly One Substring
en.description:
Choose exactly one non-empty contiguous substring and replace each letter in it with the previous letter, where a becomes z. Find the lexicographically smallest string after the operation.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string of length 1..100000.
en.output: Output the smallest string after the operation.
en.explanation: The examples give gackerrank, aabad and aaz respectively.
hints: Skip the leading a's, then decrement the following run of non-a characters; if the string is all a's, change only the last character to z.
